tool_schemas.name: cryptoCategories
tool_schemas.description: Lists cryptocurrency categories from our normalized CoinMarketCap cache and returns a paged result set using start (1-based offset) and limit. Filters may be applied by id, slug, or symbol when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid paging values or mutually invalid filters, UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the key lacks permission for this tool, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the key’s request limit is reached.

tool_schemas.name: cryptoCategory
tool_schemas.description: Returns details for a single category id from cache and, when start/limit are provided, includes the category’s paged constituent assets priced in the requested convert/convert_id. The response contains the category metadata plus a paginated list segment based on start (1-based) and limit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for a missing/invalid id, invalid paging, or invalid convert/convert_id usage, NOT_FOUND if the category id is unknown, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for key/permission failures, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when over limit.

tool_schemas.name: cryptoCurrencyMap
tool_schemas.description: Lists the cryptocurrency map (CoinMarketCap ids with identifying fields) from cache, returning a paginated result set using start (1-based) and limit and optionally filtering by listing_status and/or symbol. Results can be ordered via sort when supported by the underlying dataset and aux controls which extra fields are included. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid paging or unsupported enum values, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for key/permission failures, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the request budget is exhausted.

tool_schemas.name: getCryptoMetadata
tool_schemas.description: Returns static metadata for one or more cryptocurrencies (e.g., logo, description, URLs) looked up from cache by id, symbol, slug, and/or contract address, with optional aux field selection. If skip_invalid is false, any unknown identifier causes the request to fail; if true, unknown identifiers are omitted from the result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed identifiers or an empty/ambiguous request, NOT_FOUND when nothing matches (or when a provided identifier is missing and skip_invalid is false), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for key/permission failures, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when over limit.

tool_schemas.name: allCryptocurrencyListings
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of active cryptocurrencies with latest cached market data, using start (1-based) and limit (1–5000), with optional numeric range filters and sort/sort_dir ordering. Quotes are returned in the requested convert/convert_id when provided and aux controls additional fields included per listing. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for out-of-range limit, invalid ranges (e.g., min > max), or unsupported enum values, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for key/permission failures, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the key exceeds its allowed request volume.

tool_schemas.name: cryptoQuotesLatest
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached quote(s) for one or more cryptocurrencies selected by id, slug, and/or symbol, optionally converted via convert/convert_id and shaped by aux. If skip_invalid is false, any unknown identifier fails the request; if true, unknown identifiers are ignored and only matched assets are returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed identifiers or invalid convert/convert_id usage, NOT_FOUND when no assets match (or when a requested identifier is missing and skip_invalid is false), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for key/permission failures, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when over limit.

tool_schemas.name: dexInfo
tool_schemas.description: Returns static metadata for one or more DEX entities from cache, identified by id and optionally expanded with aux fields. If no id is supplied, the tool returns metadata for all cached DEXes in a single response (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids or aux values, NOT_FOUND when a provided id does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for key/permission failures, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the request budget is exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: dexListingsLatest
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of decentralized exchanges with latest cached aggregate market data, using start (1-based) and limit, and supporting sort/sort_dir and type filtering. Values can be returned in the requested convert_id where supported and aux controls additional fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid paging or unsupported enum values, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for key/permission failures, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the key exceeds its quota.

tool_schemas.name: dexNetworksList
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of DEX networks mapped to CoinMarketCap ids from cache, using start (1-based) and limit with optional sort/sort_dir and aux expansion. The response includes the current page of networks and paging context. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid paging or unsupported enum values, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for key/permission failures, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when over limit.

tool_schemas.name: dexSpotPairsLatest
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of active DEX spot pairs with latest cached market data, filtered by any combination of network/dex/base/quote identifiers and range constraints, and ordered via sort/sort_dir; paging is driven by scroll_id (cursor) with limit controlling page size. When convert_id is provided, numeric quote fields are returned in that currency where supported and aux controls additional fields on each pair. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids/addresses, invalid numeric ranges, or unsupported enum values, NOT_FOUND when a specified network/dex/asset filter refers to an unknown entity, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for key/permission failures, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the request limit is reached.

tool_schemas.name: dexPairsQuotesLatest
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached spot-market quote(s) for the DEX pair(s) identified by contract_address and a network selector (network_id or network_slug), optionally converted via convert_id and with optional extra fields via aux; the response is a single latest quote per resolved pair and is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the network selector is missing/ambiguous, identifiers are malformed, or mutually exclusive selectors are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if no matching pair exists (or, when skip_invalid is truthy, silently drops unknown pairs and returns only matches). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller has no remaining quota; reverse_order is rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR when the endpoint does not return an ordered list.

tool_schemas.name: dexPairsOhlcvLatest
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached OHLCV values for the current UTC day for the DEX spot pair(s) identified by contract_address and a network selector (network_id or network_slug), optionally converted via convert_id and with optional extra fields via aux; the response contains one latest daily OHLCV record per resolved pair and is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required identifiers are missing/invalid or selection is ambiguous; raises NOT_FOUND if the pair does not exist (or, when skip_invalid is truthy, omits unknown pairs). Raises UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid API keys and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when quota limits prevent the request; reverse_order is rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR when no ordered series is being returned.

tool_schemas.name: dexPairsOhlcvHistorical
tool_schemas.description: Returns cached historical OHLCV (and market cap where available) for the DEX spot pair(s) identified by contract_address and a network selector (network_id or network_slug), sampled according to interval/time_period and bounded by time_start/time_end or count; results are returned as a time-ordered series per pair, and are limited by the requested window rather than page tokens (reverse_order can invert the chronological order when supported). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when interval/time_period values are unsupported, time bounds are inconsistent, count is invalid, or the network/pair identifiers are missing or ambiguous; raises NOT_FOUND when the pair cannot be resolved (or, when skip_invalid is truthy, drops unresolved pairs). Raises UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid API keys and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when usage limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: dexPairsTradeLatest
tool_schemas.description: Returns up to the latest 100 cached trades for a single DEX spot pair identified by contract_address and a network selector (network_id or network_slug), optionally including extra fields via aux; results are returned as a list ordered by trade time, optionally reversed via reverse_order, and are not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the request resolves to zero or multiple pairs, if identifiers are malformed, or if reverse_order/aux values are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND when the pair does not exist (skip_invalid does not apply when a single pair is required). Raises UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid API keys and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller is over quota.

tool_schemas.name: exchangeAssets
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached asset/token holdings for a single exchange selected by id or slug; the response is the exchange with its assets list and is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither id nor slug is provided, if both are provided but conflict, or if the identifier format is invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the exchange cannot be resolved. Raises UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid API keys and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when quota limits block the request.

tool_schemas.name: exchangeInfo
tool_schemas.description: Returns cached metadata for one or more exchanges selected by id and/or slug, optionally including additional fields via aux; the response returns one metadata object per resolved exchange and is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if selectors are malformed or contradictory; raises NOT_FOUND when no exchanges match (or, when multiple selectors are supplied, for any selector that cannot be resolved if the request requires exact matches). Raises UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid API keys and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller has exceeded allowed usage.

tool_schemas.name: exchangeMap
tool_schemas.description: Returns a cached mapping of exchanges to unique CoinMarketCap IDs, filterable by listing_status and slug and sortable via sort; results are paged using start (1-based offset) and limit (page size), returning at most limit rows starting from start. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if start/limit are out of range, sort/listing_status values are unsupported, or slug is malformed; returns an empty page when the requested window has no rows. Raises UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid API keys and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when quota enforcement blocks the request.

tool_schemas.name: globalMetricsLatest
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached global cryptocurrency market metrics, optionally converted using convert or convert_id; the response is a single metrics object and is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if convert/convert_id are malformed or refer to unsupported conversion targets; raises NOT_FOUND if the requested conversion currency cannot be resolved. Raises UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid API keys and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the request exceeds the caller’s quota.

tool_schemas.name: cmc100IndexHistorical
tool_schemas.description: Returns cached historical CoinMarketCap 100 Index values for the requested interval, bounded by time_start/time_end or count; results are returned as a time-ordered series and are limited by the requested window rather than page tokens. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if interval is not one of the supported values, if time bounds are inconsistent, or if count is invalid; returns an empty series when no data exists for the window. Raises UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid API keys and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when usage limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: cmc100IndexLatest
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached CoinMarketCap 100 Index value along with constituents and constituent weights, optionally converted via convert or convert_id; the response is a single snapshot and is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if convert/convert_id are malformed or both are provided in an incompatible way; raises NOT_FOUND if the conversion currency cannot be resolved. Raises UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid API keys and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller is over quota.

convert.description: Optional fiat/crypto symbol to convert the index value into (e.g., "USD").

convert_id.description: Optional upstream CoinMarketCap convert currency id to convert the index value into.

tool_schemas.name: fearAndGreedLatest
tool_schemas.description: Returns the most recent cached CoinMarketCap Crypto Fear & Greed Index value, optionally using the requested aggregation time_period, and includes the index value and its associated timestamp. This endpoint does not paginate. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if time_period is not one of the supported values, UNAUTHORIZED if no valid API key is provided, FORBIDDEN if the key is disabled, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller has exhausted their allowed request quota.

time_period.description: Optional aggregation period for the cached Fear & Greed value (defaults to latest available).

tool_schemas.name: fearAndGreedHistorical
tool_schemas.description: Returns cached historical CoinMarketCap Crypto Fear & Greed Index values as a time-ordered list, paged using start (1-based offset) and limit (max 500). Results are limited to entries available in cache; if no rows match the requested page window an empty list is returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when start/limit are out of range, UNAUTHORIZED if no valid API key is provided, FORBIDDEN if the key is disabled, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller has exhausted their allowed request quota.

tool_schemas.name: fiatMap
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached fiat currency reference records mapped to unique CoinMarketCap IDs, optionally including precious metals when include_metals is true, and supports paging via start and limit with optional sort. The response is a single page of results based on the requested offsets; callers must advance start to retrieve additional pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid paging or sort inputs, UNAUTHORIZED if no valid API key is provided, FORBIDDEN if the key is disabled, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller has exhausted their allowed request quota.

tool_schemas.name: getPostmanCollection
tool_schemas.description: Returns the CoinMarketCap API Postman collection document for the requested version, or the latest available when version is omitted. This endpoint returns a single document and does not paginate. Raises NOT_FOUND if the requested version does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED if no valid API key is provided, FORBIDDEN if the key is disabled, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller has exhausted their allowed request quota.

version.description: Optional Postman collection version identifier to return (defaults to the latest).

tool_schemas.name: priceConversion
tool_schemas.description: Converts the given amount from a source currency (specified by id or symbol) into one or more target currencies (convert by symbol and/or convert_id by id) at the specified time when provided, returning the computed conversion quote(s) and the pricing timestamp used (from cached market data when available). This endpoint returns a single conversion result set and does not paginate. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if amount is missing/invalid, if neither id nor symbol is provided, if both convert and convert_id are empty, or if time is not a valid timestamp; raises NOT_FOUND when the referenced source or target currency cannot be resolved in cache for the request, UNAUTHORIZED if no valid API key is provided, FORBIDDEN if the key is disabled, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller has exhausted their allowed request quota.

tool_schemas.name: keyInfo
tool_schemas.description: Returns API key metadata and current usage statistics for the API key identified by api_key_id or key_prefix. This endpoint returns a single record and does not paginate. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if both identifiers are omitted or malformed, NOT_FOUND if no API key record matches the provided identifier, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to read key details.

api_key_id.description: Internal API key id (cmc_key_... ULID) to fetch details for.

key_prefix.description: Public key prefix to look up an API key record (alternative to api_key_id).

tool_schemas.name: createApiKey
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key record for this service and returns the created api_keys row. Refuses VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid limits/plan/status, FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot manage keys, and CONFLICT when label or key_prefix collides with an existing key under the same account.

api_key.description: CoinMarketCap MCP API key presented by the caller (raw), used to authorize key management.

plan.description: Plan name associated with this key for quota enforcement.

tool_schemas.name: updateApiKey
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing api_keys record and returns the updated row. Supports changing label/plan/limits and driving lifecycle transitions via status. Refuses VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields or illegal status transitions, NOT_FOUND when id does not exist, and FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot manage keys.

api_key.description: CoinMarketCap MCP API key presented by the caller (raw), used to authorize key management.

id.description: Primary id of the api_keys row to update.

requests_per_minute_limit.description: Updated per-minute request limit; 0 means unlimited.

requests_per_day_limit.description: Updated per-day request limit; 0 means unlimited.

monthly_credit_limit.description: Updated per-month credit limit; 0 means unlimited.

status.description: Sets the key status; only allowed transitions are active→suspended/revoked, suspended→active/revoked.

tool_schemas.name: requestLogs
tool_schemas.description: Lists request log rows for the authenticated key (or, when permitted, for a specified api_key_id) in reverse chronological order with pagination. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credential, FORBIDDEN when the caller requests logs outside its entitlement, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid paging or filter enums.

api_key.description: CoinMarketCap MCP API key presented by the caller (raw).

api_key_id.description: Filter to a specific api_key_id when the caller is permitted to audit multiple keys.

tool_name.description: Filter by tool name exactly (e.g., cryptoQuotesLatest).

time_start.description: Inclusive ISO-8601 timestamp lower bound on created_at.

time_end.description: Inclusive ISO-8601 timestamp upper bound on created_at.

tool_schemas.name: cachedResponse
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single cached_responses entry by (tool_name, params_fingerprint). Returns the cached response payload and metadata when present; refuses NOT_FOUND when no record exists, and FORBIDDEN when the caller is not entitled to inspect cached upstream responses.

api_key.description: CoinMarketCap MCP API key presented by the caller (raw).

tool_name.description: Tool name that produced the cached response.

params_fingerprint.description: Deterministic fingerprint of schema-allowed request_params used as the cache key.

include_body.description: When true, includes response_body; when false, returns metadata only.

tool_schemas.name: refreshCache
tool_schemas.description: Schedules an asynchronous refresh from upstream CoinMarketCap for a supported cached dataset and returns a refresh job acknowledgement. Refuses VALIDATION_ERROR for unsupported targets or missing identifiers, FORBIDDEN if the key is not allowed to trigger refresh, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when refresh operations are subject to limits.

api_key.description: CoinMarketCap MCP API key presented by the caller (raw).

entity_type.description: When target=asset_directory, limits refresh to an entity type.

id.description: Upstream id (or internal id where applicable) to refresh when scope=by_id.

tool_name.description: Tool name for cached response refresh when target=cached_responses.

params_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint for cached response refresh when scope=by_fingerprint.

force.description: When true, refresh even if records are currently fresh/valid.
